parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A wheel of the trashcan made of rubber, typically circular and attached to the lower rear side of the bin.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be moved easily by rolling on the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable movement of the trashcan.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second wheel of the trashcan made of rubber, identical to the first wheel and located on the opposite side.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other wheel to balance and support the trashcan during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable smooth rolling motion.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan made of HDPE plastic, hinged at the top to cover the opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps pests or rainwater out of the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward around the hinge to open and downward to close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the trashcan made of HDPE plastic, forming the container that holds waste.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary storage compartment for waste materials.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the lid and wheels.
